terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

# Variables
variable "username" {
  description = "IAM user name"
  type        = string
  default     = "my_vpn_infra_user"
}

variable "group_name" {
  description = "IAM group name"
  type        = string
  default     = "my-vpn-infra-group"
}

variable "membership_name" {
  description = "Group membership name"
  type        = string
  default     = "my-vpn-infra-manager-group"
}

variable "project_tag" {
  description = "Value for the ProjectTag tag"
  type        = string
  default     = "my-vpn-tag"
}

variable "policy_path" {
  description = "Path for IAM policies"
  type        = string
  default     = "/my_vpn_infra/"
}

# IAM User
resource "aws_iam_user" "infra_user" {
  name          = var.username
  force_destroy = true
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

# IAM Group
resource "aws_iam_group" "infra_group" {
  name = var.group_name
}

# Group Membership
resource "aws_iam_group_membership" "infra_group_membership" {
  name  = var.membership_name
  users = [aws_iam_user.infra_user.name]
  group = aws_iam_group.infra_group.name
}

# Access Key
resource "aws_iam_access_key" "infra_user_key" {
  user   = aws_iam_user.infra_user.name
  status = "Active"
}

# Policy Documents
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "basic_policy" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "sts:GetCallerIdentity"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "create_policy" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
      "ec2:CreateVpc",
      "ec2:CreateSubnet",
      "ec2:CreateInternetGateway",
      "ec2:CreateRoute",
      "ec2:CreateRouteTable",
      "ec2:CreateLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociation",
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:CreateReplaceRootVolumeTask",
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:AllocateAddress"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "read_policy" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ec2:GetConsoleOutput",
      "ec2:GetPasswordData",
      "ec2:GetLaunchTemplateData",
      "ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault",
      "ec2:GetManagedPrefixListEntries",
      "ec2:SearchLocalGatewayRoutes",
      "ec2:DescribeLocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociations",
      "ec2:DescribeLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociations",
      "ec2:DescribeLocalGateways",
      "ec2:DescribeLocalGatewayRouteTables",
      "ec2:DescribeLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroups",
      "ec2:DescribeLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaces",
      "ec2:GetAssociatedIpv6PoolCidrs",
      "ec2:GetCapacityReservationUsage",
      "ec2:GetCoipPoolUsage",
      "ec2:GetConsoleScreenshot",
      "ec2:GetDefaultCreditSpecification",
      "ec2:GetGroupsForCapacityReservation",
      "ec2:GetHostReservationPurchasePreview",
      "ec2:GetInstanceTypesFromInstanceRequirements",
      "ec2:GetInstanceUefiData",
      "ec2:GetIpamAddressHistory",
      "ec2:GetIpamDiscoveredAccounts",
      "ec2:GetIpamDiscoveredResourceCidrs",
      "ec2:GetIpamPoolAllocations",
      "ec2:GetIpamPoolCidrs",
      "ec2:GetIpamResourceCidrs",
      "ec2:GetLaunchTemplateData",
      "ec2:GetManagedPrefixListAssociations",
      "ec2:GetNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysisFindings",
      "ec2:GetNetworkInsightsAccessScopeContent",
      "ec2:GetPasswordData",
      "ec2:GetReservedInstancesExchangeQuote",
      "ec2:GetSerialConsoleAccessStatus",
      "ec2:GetSpotPlacementScores",
      "ec2:GetSubnetCidrReservations",
      "ec2:GetTransitGatewayAttachmentPropagations",
      "ec2:GetTransitGatewayMulticastDomainAssociations",
      "ec2:GetTransitGatewayPrefixListReferences",
      "ec2:GetTransitGatewayRouteTableAssociations",
      "ec2:GetTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagations",
      "ec2:GetVpnConnectionDeviceSampleConfiguration",
      "ec2:GetVpnConnectionDeviceTypes",
      "ec2:ListImagesInRecycleBin",
      "ec2:ListSnapshotsInRecycleBin"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "update_policy" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:Modify*",
      "ec2:Associate*",
      "ec2:Attach*",
      "ec2:Replace*",
      "ec2:Enable*",
      "ec2:AcceptVpcPeeringConnection",
      "ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsEgress",
      "ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsIngress",
      "ec2:ResetImageAttribute",
      "ec2:ResetInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:ResetNetworkInterfaceAttribute",
      "ec2:ResetSnapshotAttribute",
      "ec2:RestoreAddressToClassic",
      "ec2:RestoreImageFromRecycleBin",
      "ec2:RestoreManagedPrefixListVersion",
      "ec2:RestoreSnapshotFromRecycleBin",
      "ec2:RestoreSnapshotTier",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:ModifyAvailabilityZoneGroup",
      "ec2:ModifyCapacityReservation",
      "ec2:ModifyCapacityReservationFleet",
      "ec2:ModifyClientVpnEndpoint",
      "ec2:ModifyDefaultCreditSpecification",
      "ec2:ModifyEbsDefaultKmsKeyId",
      "ec2:ModifyFleet",
      "ec2:ModifyFpgaImageAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyHosts",
      "ec2:ModifyIdFormat",
      "ec2:ModifyIdentityIdFormat",
      "ec2:ModifyImageAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceCapacityReservationAttributes",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceCreditSpecification",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceEventStartTime",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceMaintenanceOptions",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions",
      "ec2:ModifyInstancePlacement",
      "ec2:ModifyIpam",
      "ec2:ModifyIpamPool",
      "ec2:ModifyIpamResourceCidr",
      "ec2:ModifyIpamScope",
      "ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate",
      "ec2:ModifyLocalGatewayRoute",
      "ec2:ModifyManagedPrefixList",
      "ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyPrivateDnsNameOptions",
      "ec2:ModifyReservedInstances",
      "ec2:ModifySecurityGroupRules",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotTier",
      "ec2:ModifySpotFleetRequest",
      "ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyTrafficMirrorFilterNetworkServices",
      "ec2:ModifyTrafficMirrorFilterRule",
      "ec2:ModifyTrafficMirrorSession",
      "ec2:ModifyTransitGateway",
      "ec2:ModifyTransitGatewayPrefixListReference",
      "ec2:ModifyTransitGatewayVpcAttachment",
      "ec2:ModifyVolume",
      "ec2:ModifyVolumeAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint",
      "ec2:ModifyVpcEndpointConnectionNotification",
      "ec2:ModifyVpcEndpointServiceConfiguration",
      "ec2:ModifyVpcEndpointServicePayerResponsibility",
      "ec2:ModifyVpcEndpointServicePermissions",
      "ec2:ModifyVpcPeeringConnectionOptions",
      "ec2:ModifyVpcTenancy",
      "ec2:ModifyVpnConnection",
      "ec2:ModifyVpnConnectionOptions",
      "ec2:ModifyVpnTunnelCertificate",
      "ec2:ModifyVpnTunnelOptions"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "delete_policy" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:Delete*",
      "ec2:Detach*",
      "ec2:Disassociate*",
      "ec2:ReleaseAddress"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "instance_policy" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:RunInstances",
      "ec2:StartInstances",
      "ec2:ResetInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:StopInstances",
      "ec2:TerminateInstances",
      "ec2:RebootInstances"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "terraform_backend_access" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "dynamodb:DescribeTable",
      "dynamodb:GetItem",
      "dynamodb:PutItem",
      "dynamodb:DeleteItem",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:PutObject",
      "s3:DeleteObject"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

# IAM Policies
resource "aws_iam_policy" "basic_policy" {
  name        = "basic_policy"
  path        = var.policy_path
  description = "Basic STS policy"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.basic_policy.json
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "create_policy" {
  name        = "create_policy"
  path        = var.policy_path
  description = "EC2 create actions policy"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.create_policy.json
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "read_policy" {
  name        = "read_policy"
  path        = var.policy_path
  description = "EC2 read actions policy"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.read_policy.json
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "update_policy" {
  name        = "update_policy"
  path        = var.policy_path
  description = "EC2 update/modify actions policy"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.update_policy.json
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "delete_policy" {
  name        = "delete_policy"
  path        = var.policy_path
  description = "EC2 delete/detach actions policy"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.delete_policy.json
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "instance_policy" {
  name        = "instance_policy"
  path        = var.policy_path
  description = "EC2 instance lifecycle actions policy"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.instance_policy.json
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "terraform_backend_access" {
  name        = "terraform_backend_access"
  path        = var.policy_path
  description = "DynamoDB and S3 backend access policy"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.terraform_backend_access.json
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

# Policy Attachments to Group
resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "basic_policy_attach" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.infra_group.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.basic_policy.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "create_policy_attach" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.infra_group.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.create_policy.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "read_policy_attach" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.infra_group.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.read_policy.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "update_policy_attach" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.infra_group.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.update_policy.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "delete_policy_attach" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.infra_group.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.delete_policy.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "instance_policy_attach" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.infra_group.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.instance_policy.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "terraform_backend_access_attach" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.infra_group.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.terraform_backend_access.arn
}
